name: Frequency-Aware Adaptive Splat Spawning
definition: A method to spawn new splats in regions of high frequency content or low opacity (holes) by scoring pixels based on high-frequency gaps and alpha gaps, then sampling new splats from the nearest existing cloud points.
summary: Frequency-Aware Adaptive Splat Spawning is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification strategy that spawns splats in high-frequency or low-opacity regions by scoring pixels based on frequency and alpha gaps, distinguishing itself by explicitly incorporating image frequency analysis into splitting decisions.
